variantLabel: var2-routing (vision_check; classifier dispatches; allow-list-aware; full extract→measure-distance chain executing end-to-end; runs=3)
notes: **Headline run for var-2 on el-md-exp.** Local conductor execution (npm run conduct --step=review-runs --runs=3) — bypasses Substation/Inngest cloud path which was hanging on RUN_4/RUN_5 attempts. Retires the runs-disparity confounder from RUN_6_BACKUP_LOCAL.

89 vision_check calls. Classifier intent: generic=61, measurement=28, drawing_inspect=0. 22 measurement-routed calls produced ≥1 pair → measure-distance ran 22 times → 99/99 per-pair distance measurements computed (100% subprocess success, Goal C=100% on the Goal-B-eligible denominator).
**Goal A** (strict majority, any vision invoked on expected_vision=yes): 25/51 = 49.0% (best yet — beats RUN_3's 47.1%).
**Goal B** (canonical intent = measurement on expected_specialist=measure-distance): 14/51 = 27.5% (nearly doubled vs RUN_3's 15.7% — runs=3 gives the classifier more chances).
**Goal B' / Goal C absolute** (chain actually executed): 11/51 = 21.6%. Gap between B and B' is 3 items where the classifier picked measurement but the extractor returned 0 pairs (so md never ran).
**Goal C conditional on B** (specialist returned data | specialist correctly selected): 11/14 = 78.6%.

**Verdict comparison vs ctrl** (both runs=3): 15 items had successful measure-distance. 4 items moved from ctrl `not-verifiable` majority → RUN_7 real verdict (3 pass, 0 fail). 1 of those was unanimous (EL-13.33: `not-verifiable:3` → `pass:3`).

**Goal D emerged as the iter-2 follow-up**: on multiple items where the chain ran cleanly, the agent's post-measurement verdict didn't escalate. Notably EL-2.1 (ctrl unanimous fail → RUN_7 unanimous not-verifiable despite 9 distance measurements) and EL-1.37 (13 measurements, same verdict distribution as ctrl). See `compare-vs-ctrl.md` + `analysis.md`.

**Caveats persist:** scaleInchesPerFoot=0.05 hardcoded (RUN_7 max distance 395.2 ft, min 0.0 ft — both worth spot-checking); EL-13.13 stayed not-verifiable across all 3 runs despite measure-distance succeeding.
Supersedes RUN_6_BACKUP_LOCAL (workflow_runs.id f9e578b3-94f5-4fa6-8fca-6f49c1f029f4; runs=1; same fixed chain but single-run variance). RUN_6 in turn superseded RUN_3 (chain broken pre-fix).

specialistCallStatus.note: Goal C (correct tool execution) = 100% of measure-distance subprocesses returned ≥1 distance. The 6 cases where extract-measurement-pairs returned 0 pairs (so md never invoked) are misroute candidates for classifier prompt tuning.

supersedes.reason: RUN_6 was runs=1 (local backup because Substation cloud path was hanging). RUN_7 is runs=3 — same fixed chain, retires the variance confounder on Goal A. Headline numbers shift upward across A/B/B'.
